subject: Add OpenZFS as git submodule
description:
Phase 2 of ZFS update: Integrate OpenZFS source as git submodule.

Tasks:
1. Add git submodule: external/openzfs from https://github.com/openzfs/zfs.git
2. Checkout latest stable release (e.g., zfs-2.2.6)
3. Create mapping document bsd/sys/cddl/OPENZFS_MAPPING.md:
   - Map old FreeBSD paths to new OpenZFS paths
   - Document renamed/reorganized files
   - Note API changes (ABD, taskq, ARC)

Prerequisites:
- Task 1 must be complete (need to understand current structure)

Timeline: 1 week
activeForm: Adding OpenZFS as git submodule and creating mapping document
